about.title: About
about.heroTitle: Sheeting and terry workshops we already run.
about.heroDescription: Hotel sheet sets, bath towels and curtains. Embroidery and certified lots when the order names them.
about.workflowDescription: Finish and volume decide the line. The sample set and the logo proof decide when packing starts.
about.closingTitle: Have a property or a collection to place?
about.closingDescription: Send a room list or a reference set. We reply with a workshop and an MOQ.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heroDescription: A sample set, a logo, or a hotel PO — write to the person who will follow the SKU.

collections.title: Products
collections.heroDescription: Bedding, terry, curtains, table linen and embroidered pieces.
collections.benefitsTitle: What you get on a quote
collections.benefitsDescription: Workshop, MOQ, sample date, GSM or thread count.
collections.stylesDescription: Hotels, retail shelves and fitted-out rooms.

hotels.title: For hospitality
hotels.description: The same SKU, year after year.
hotels.content: Guestroom sets and embroidered bath. We keep the SKU card so a replenishment does not become a new development.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.description: A colour story, packed for the shelf.
retailers.content: Seasonal bedding and terry. Size runs and gift-box packs are written on the PO before the lot is made.

developers.title: For property developers
developers.content: Sheeting, curtains and bath pieces specified together, so a studio and a one-bed do not arrive as two different whites.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: A set on a bed. A logo on terry.
sampling.content: Send a room list or artwork. We make a set you can photograph, and a proof on the actual towel.

moq.title: MOQ & lead time
moq.description: Quoted per SKU, not per catalogue.
moq.content: A sample set can be a few units. Bulk is by property or by colourway. Dates are written on the quote.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: OEKO-TEX and the hotel standard you name.
certifications.content: We place the SKU in a workshop that already holds the certificate. The scope file travels with the lot.

quality-control.title: Quality control
quality-control.content: Final audit covers stitch, finish, embroidery, set completeness and carton count. The report is signed before the truck leaves.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.content: Send the list → pick the workshop → sign the set → make the lot → count cartons. The merchandiser stays on the SKU.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content: Sample-set time, SKU MOQ, embroidery proofs and packing — written before you open a bulk PO.

blog.title: Blog
blog.content: Hotel specs, certificates and how a set is packed.

workflow.title: Sign the set
workflow.description: SKU and logo on the real goods.

workflow.title: Make and count
workflow.description: Finish on the line, sets at the door.

packageBenefits.title: SKU card first
packageBenefits.description: Size and finish before the lot.

packageBenefits.title: Sample-set gate
packageBenefits.description: No packing without a signed set.
